column1: # Same columns and meaning as bench/riscv/experiments.tsv:
# build   native  (= -march=native; the only x86 build)
# threads OpenMP thread count, 1 for serial kernels
#   A  baseline   scalar_f32, auto-vectorization off, 1 thread
#   B  intrinsic  avx512_f32, the port of rvv_f32_m2, 1 thread
#   C  omp        scalar_omp_f32, auto-vectorization off, thread sweep
# The intrinsic row keeps cflags "-" exactly as the RISC-V intrinsic rows do,
# so the code around the hand-written loop is compiled the same way on both.
# Unlike the RISC-V omp rows, the omp rows here also disable the vectorizer,
# so cell C is the cell A source plus OpenMP and nothing else.
# Threads are pinned one per physical core by run_bench.sh; 64 fits within
